I am writing to apply for the Social Media Manager position with your client, a global leader in consumer electronics. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am excited about the opportunity to own the publishing and reporting for all social channels and contribute to building a culturally relevant brand.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills align with this role. Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
